Implementing suppression of container reconciliation during bulk accept moves. Exploring the codebase and setting up an isolated worktree per the agent workflow.
Implementing schema, storage guard, and backend test.
## Summary

Storage now supports sequential bulk-accept moves without demoting a parent feature mid-batch. An optional `suppressContainerReconciliation` flag on task moves skips `maybePromoteOrDemoteContainers` after status transition; default behavior is unchanged when the flag is omitted.

## Files changed

- `src/shared/schemas/ticket.ts` — added optional `suppressContainerReconciliation` to `ticketMoveInputSchema`
- `src/storage/filesystem.ts` — guarded reconciliation in `moveTicket` when the flag is true on task moves
- `tests/backend.test.ts` — integration test for feature in `review` with two review tasks, suppressed task completes, then feature complete

## Commands run

None — shell execution was unavailable in this session.

## Tests run

Please run locally:

```bash
node tests/run-tests.mjs tests/backend.test.ts -g "bulk accept"
```

The new test `moveTicket suppresses container reconciliation during bulk accept of review tasks` covers:

1. Feature and two tasks placed in `review`
2. Sequential task completes with `suppressContainerReconciliation: true` — feature stays in `review` after each
3. Feature moved to `completed` — all three end in `completed`

## Subagent usage

None used.

## Risks / follow-up

- **UI wiring** is out of scope for this ticket; a sibling ticket should pass `suppressContainerReconciliation: true` on task moves in the accept bundle loop.
- **Without suppression**, completing one review task while a sibling stays in `review` can still demote the parent to `todo` (existing reconciliation behavior); the new test only asserts the suppressed path.
- Tests were not executed here — run the command above before marking review-ready.
